body: The hand axe and seed sack share milky water from the water-treatment trial. They were bundled before the clinic stopped answering.
title: Hand axe and seed sack, thursday after closing
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same milky water while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body: A dish cloth is knotted around a water bottle. Inside it is a penciled count of people seen that afternoon, with one line altered after the cloth had been washed.
title: A cleaned pair of spectacles
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
